openQuestions: `vendor/README.md` still names the retired `cam init`/`cam next` forms in prose (lines 3, 11, 15, 41, 45); it is not embedded into `src/vendor/_generated.ts` and is outside the story's cited AC1 (66) / AC2 (46) scopes, so it was left untouched per surgical-changes discipline -- flagging as a real but out-of-scope residual for a future doc-hygiene story.

The reviewer's `worker-report.json`/finding text described AC1 as 66 matches and AC2 as 46 matches under a widened terminator; my own re-run of the widened-terminator scan (full AC1 command list, boundary `(^|[^a-zA-Z_/-])cam ($CMDS)([^a-zA-Z0-9_-]|$)`) found 68 in AC1 scope and, after accounting for two markdown line-wrap splits a per-line regex misses, a total of 46 in AC2 scope once vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts's two embedded comment mentions of `cam init` are included alongside templates/'s 2 -- both counts now measure 0 post-fix; the small discrepancy from the story's 66 (mine found 68) is most likely a different exact command token list used by the planner's manual count vs. mine, not a missed file, since a post-fix full-scope re-scan (collapsed-newline included) returns zero in both scopes.
nextStoryContext: The `cam` -> `gship`/`gateship` typed-command migration (ADR-0054) that US-005 believed complete is now actually complete under the widened, backtick-aware boundary `([^a-zA-Z0-9_-]|$)`: AC1 scope (.claude/agents, .claude/commands, .claude/skills, .claude/hooks, templates/, scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, excluding the four pinned history files journal.md/journal.archive.md/patterns.md/patterns.archive.md) and AC2 scope (src/vendor/_generated.ts, which embeds templates/ whole-dir plus three named vendor/ files listed in scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts's FILES const) both re-scanned to 0 remaining `cam <subcommand>` matches with the wide terminator, verified twice: once as a raw grep and once against newline-collapsed file content (to catch markdown-wrapped code spans a per-line perl substitution silently skips -- two such wraps were found and hand-fixed in subagent-orchestrator.md, present in both the .claude/ and templates/ copies). `bun run embed-vendor` was re-run after every source edit (templates/ and vendor/) and `embed-vendor:check` is clean. All five US-005 AC5 pinned internal-contract counts (CAM_=164, .cam-=153, tmux -L cam=3, /cam-=205, all measured in src+index.ts against main) are unchanged, and the four historical-prose files were not touched. Full `bun run check:all` is green (5960 pass / 0 fail, coverage/debt-markers/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet all ok). `vendor/README.md` (not embedded, not in either AC's scope) still carries stale `cam init`/`cam next` prose mentions -- left alone per this story's exact scope, flagged in openQuestions as a real residual for a future pass. Next non-operator, passes:false story by priority is whatever the reviewer/planner has staged next in prd.json (none pre-staged as of this handoff, unlike the US-R1-001 -> US-R1-002 handoff).
